en.hubeali: From him, from Ahmad, from Safwan, from Aban, from Fuzayl who said,
‘[58:22] these are they into whose hearts He has Impressed the faith,
is it for them regarding what is Impressed in their hearts, say (control over it)?’
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the above narrator from Ahmad from Safwan from Aban from Fudayl who has said the following: “
about the words of Allah, ‘These are those into whose hearts belief is written. . . .’ [58:22]
, do they have any say in what is written into their hearts?
The Imam said, ‘No, they do not have any say in it. ’”
